mechanism.family_1: REPEATED_POST_LATTICE groups vertical door-frame segments sharing top and bottom boundaries into one multi-leaf functional portal set.
mechanism.family_2: PAIRED_VERTICAL_HANDLE_APERTURE pairs aligned vertical handles or posts and infers a door aperture from their observed scale.
mechanism.fusion: Rank both structural families together and preserve the top three as a set-valued functional portal proposal. Target identity remains a separate prerequisite authority.

development.claim: Mechanism development only; both sources were consumed before the final dual-family representation.

fresh_confirmation.source: Six frozen Commons glass entrances from Chater House, Inland Revenue Centre, The Wings, Cheng Yu Tung Building, The Gateway, and Cheung Lee Commercial Building.

next_step: Feed top-three functional portal proposals into the scale-gated active entrance belief only after a separately confirmed target-entity lock. Acquire an ordered or commanded-view source before evaluating temporal commit, reacquisition, guidance, or SkyDiscover policy search.
claim_scope: Fresh current-image glass-entrance proposal retention only. This does not establish requested-entity identity, public access, traversability, temporal tracking, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
